//Note: Test code originally generated by Gemini, use at your own risk!


1.  Step 1: produce messages and cause the address to exceed global max size.  This class produces lots of data to the FOO queue.  The configured global max size of 100MB is exceeded and then the address enters paging mode as a result.

     mvn clean compile  exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="com.test.PagingProducer"

2.  Step 2: consume messages in batches to force message to remain in-flight while waiting for acknowledgment.  The messages are depaged and remain in memory.  When the system detects it cannot depage another page, you will see:


     mvn clean compile  exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="com.test.BatchConsumer"

WARN  [org.apache.activemq.artemis.core.server.Queue] AMQ224127: Message dispatch from paging is blocked. Address FOO/Queue FOO will not read any more messages from paging until pending messages are acknowledged. There are currently 20 messages pending (20975580 bytes) with max reads at maxPageReadMessages(-1) and maxPageReadBytes(20971520). Either increase reading attributes at the address-settings or change your consumers to acknowledge more often.
